signals_traced.reason: confirm trigger programming and enable state
confirm load address match and side-effect suppression
trace the precise exception through recovery

observations: At VCD time 4161 the load address is 0x10000000, memory_trigger_match asserts, raw load enqueue is suppressed, and an exception completion is produced.
The trap redirect initially selects mtvec 0x00000014, but a registered younger branch_miss remains asserted after full_flush and changes the later redirect target to 0x00000148.
The failing path reaches test code 4 only after the stale branch redirect bypasses the trap handler.

root_cause.description: full_flush clears execution state but does not clear registered branch recovery state, allowing a younger branch redirect to overwrite a precise trigger trap redirect on the following cycle
root_cause.evidence: memory_trigger_match=1 at time 4161; full_flush redirects to 0x14 at 4163; branch_miss remains 1 at 4165; subsequent redirect target becomes 0x148

fix_recommendation.description: Give full_flush priority over registered branch recovery state; separately enforce CSR privilege/read-only legality and suppress minstret auto-increment on direct counter writes.
